behavioral_walls: The declaration-only classes still lack behavior in the ObjC C ABI: navigation stack, window lifecycle, table data source/delegate dispatch, text editing, gestures, bars, alerts, image loading, and CoreData.
The generated Simplenote-Swift.h remains a measured Clang-before-Swift build-order wall.
measurement.method: Unique UIKit class/member declarations referenced by the 50 ObjC translation units, compared with ObjCFacade/include/UIKit.h before this pass. Constants and generated Swift-header symbols are excluded. An interface gap and each selector/property gap count once.
